correctness.evidence: Independent exact hull/area/polar computations reproduce all 16 Mahler products and boundary counts; symmetry testing gives exactly two symmetric parallelograms of product 8 and one symmetric hexagon of product 9.

originality.evidence: Grassi–Gugiatti–Lutz–Petracci 2023, DOI 10.1007/s12215-023-00922-3, §3.5 gives all 16 polygons ordered by normalized volume and the polar pairings P3/P9, 3 P4/P8 pairs, 2 P5/P7 pairs, and four P6 self-dual classes. Since Euclidean area=Vol/2, the claimed Mahler spectrum and multiplicities follow immediately.

value.evidence: The remaining symmetric-subfamily gap is a direct check of three cases inside the 16-class list; it provides no new general stability estimate, structural theorem, or reusable method.

checked_sources.title: A. Grassi, G. Gugiatti, W. Lutz, A. Petracci, Reflexive polygons and rational elliptic surfaces
checked_sources.finding: 16 classes ordered by normalized volume, complete polar pairings, and Vol(P)+Vol(P°)=12.
